paragraphs: Most failures happen because certificates, meds, and contacts live in different chats. For pet travel folder: print vs digital, put the fact table above into one place first—then attach PDFs to each pet profile.

sections.heading: How to share without texting five PDFs
paragraphs: Create or update each pet in PetClues, invite the caregiver or co-parent with read-only access, and send one link for print vs digital pet travel folder. Movers, sitters, boarding desks, and family members can open the same packet on their phone.
If someone only needs weekend access, revoke or rotate the share after the handoff instead of leaving a permanent camera-roll gallery of records.

sections.heading: Timing windows that block trips
paragraphs: Health certificates often expire in days, not weeks. Build print vs digital pet travel folder around the clinic appointment and airline or border rules, then store the PDF on the pet profile the same afternoon.
International routes need longer lead time for titers or tapeworm treatments—put those dates on the profile so co-travelers see the same countdown.
